### last time

*  cache lookup [set-associative]
   *  address = tag:index:offset
   *  lookup set (row) with index from address
   *  check each block in set from valid + tag matching
*  replacement policies
   *  least recently used (RLU) = best for locality
   *  LRU requires updating cache on (some) hits
   *  lower bookkeeping options: approx of LRU, FIFO, random
